final: WITH item_town_stats AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) as avg_price, AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS FLOAT) / CAST(ili.derived_total_cost AS FLOAT)) as avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE ili.product_price IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_stats AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) as town_avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) as town_avg_ratio FROM item_town_stats GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, town_avg_price, town_avg_ratio, town_avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(town_avg_ratio) FROM town_stats) as excess_ratio FROM town_stats WHERE town_avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(town_avg_ratio) FROM town_stats) ORDER BY town_city
